pretexts: caller claims to be law enforcement from China or Hong Kong
victim falsely accused of being involved in criminal activity
caller claims to represent Public Safety Bureau or international public safety authorities
victim told they face arrest, deportation or legal consequences
target_groups: individuals with ties to mainland China or Hong Kong
emerging_tactics: caller provides personal information about victim to appear credible

kill_chain_signals.pretext: falsely accused of being involved in criminal activity and told to cooperate with a supposed investigation
kill_chain_signals.payment: instructed to travel or transfer funds, convert money into gold or other high-value assets
kill_chain_signals.movement: directed to surrender assets to individuals posing as officers of the law such as anti-corruption officials

red_flags: You receive an unsolicited call or message from someone claiming to be law enforcement and the caller accuses you of being involved in a crime or criminal investigation
You are told to keep the situation secret from family or friends
You are pressured to act quickly or face arrest, deportation or legal consequences
You are instructed to travel, withdraw funds, or convert money into gold
The caller provides personal information about you to appear credible
key_quote: Fraudsters claim to represent agencies such as the Public Safety Bureau (PSB) or other international public safety authorities.
title: Extortion targeting Asian communities – law enforcement impersonation
